prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, B2B lead gen, e‑commerce, branding), your budget, timeline, and how you like to work with partners. I can help you find the best fit. To get you started, here’s a quick, practical approach:

How to choose the “best” agency for you
- Define goals: lead volume vs. revenue, brand awareness, customer retention, etc.  
- Services required: SEO, paid search, social ads, content, email, CRO, web development, analytics.  
- Budget & timeline: monthly retainer, project fee, expected start date.  
- Industry experience: agencies that have case studies in your vertical usually ramp faster.  
- Proof of results: ask for case studies with metrics (traffic, leads, CPA, ROI).  
- Certifications & tools: Google Partner, Facebook Marketing Partner, HubSpot, analytics tooling.  
- Team & communication: who will do the work, meeting cadence, reporting frequency.  
- Contract & transparency: clear scope, KPIs, cancellation terms, pricing model.  

Where to find and compare local agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity for ranked reviews and case studies.  
- Google Partner directory for PPC specialists.  
- LinkedIn and local business groups for referrals and recent client feedback.  
- Local awards/publications and the Better Business Bureau for reputation checks.  

Questions to ask any agency in your shortlist
- Can you show recent case studies with measurable results for businesses like ours?  
- Who will be on our account and how much of the work is in‑house vs outsourced?  
- What KPIs do you recommend and how often will you report?  
- What is your typical onboarding process and expected timeline to see results?  
- What is the pricing model and minimum contract length?  
- Can you share client references I can contact?

If you want, I can:
- Find and short-list 3–5 well-reviewed St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs, or  
- Draft an outreach template and a comparison spreadsheet you can use to evaluate proposals.

Tell me your business type, top goals, monthly budget range, and which services you need — I’ll pull a personalized short list.
